text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just moments before the decisive Tenno
Sho (Autumn).
Mejiro Ardan confides that being 
able to walk alongside the Trainer up to 
this day has brought her true happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Mejiro Ardan,
reflecting deeply on the 
hoofprints she had shared with her
beloved 
rivals, Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she headed into the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), the promised focal point of 
history.
